_doc: PROGRAM_SYNTHESIS_ARC6_D.md / PROGRAM_SYNTHESIS_ARC6_M0_CD.md Ceiling D: the 36-task honest structural residual (PROGRAM_SYNTHESIS_ARC4_STRUCTURAL_NOTES.md) each admits a real, prompt-entailed, execution-verified property the accepted (wrong) IR VIOLATES. This table is the theorem_constructions.json-shaped analogue for PROGRAM-shaped content instead of group-theoretic content: a PropertyAtom names a phrase cue (what the spec must say to even consider the atom), an arg_count guard, a NAMED reference relation (domains/prog_property.py's ref_* registry -- external domain knowledge, elementary geometry/number theory/string-collection semantics, never a task's held-out row), and a small set of hand-constructed WITNESS envs (never a held-out row) at which the reference is checked against the candidate's own executed output. `arg_count`/`phrases` are a MATCH guard only; the actual REFUTATION decision requires the reference to ALSO self-verify against the goal's own revealed rows (domains/prog_property.py::_self_verify_atom) before it may fire at all -- a property the revealed data itself contradicts is refused, never applied.
_doc_property_atoms: Each atom: `id` (unique name), `task_hint` (the MBPP task id this was derived from, for provenance/traceability only -- matching is by phrase+arg_count+self-verify, never by task id), `kind` (the property FAMILY, drawn from what the ceiling probe actually found across the 36 -- geometric_formula / modular_condition / set_membership / counting_cardinality / bit_operation / monotonic_bound / closed_form_formula / recurrence_identity / arithmetic_relation / relational_identity / predicate_check / input_output_relation), `phrases` (ALL must appear, case-insensitive substring, in the goal's own prompt text), `arg_count` (the reference relation's required argument count), `reference` (the domains/prog_property.py ref_* function name), `witnesses` (env dicts -- keyword args matching the reference's own parameter names, the MBPP single-letter convention).

a number is a difference of two squares iff a % 4 != 2.
divisibility by 11 (a % 11 == 0).
